messages:
eva (AcmeMaps): Hey team — customer flagged a charge spike on invoice INV-20286. Dashboard shows ~2.1M tokens for Feb, invoice shows 2.9M. They only used streaming chat RPCs. Can we triage?

maria (Support): Sorry about that, eva. Do we have a request_id or sample session from them?

eva (AcmeMaps): Yes — they sent logs. Main session id: r-8b3f2a. They said the client disconnects twice during a single user turn and then reconnects.

julian (Billing): Quick note: invoices are generated from raw token-event stream (emit_token events), dashboards aggregate finalized request records. If streaming token events are emitted but never reconciled to a finalized request, dashboard could undercount while invoice counts raw events.

ashok (SRE): Good context. Can we pull emit_token events for r-8b3f2a? I can search the metering ELK for "request_id:r-8b3f2a AND event:emit_token".

kevin (Runtime): I grabbed the snippet from customer-provided network trace. They use SSE and do an explicit abort after ~1.3s, then reconnect with the same client session and a new request_id. The runtime emits token events as chunks are generated, independent of finalization. If the reconnect triggers a fallback (model variant), we might see tokens from both runs billed.

maria (Support): Can you paste the trace?

kevin (Runtime): Here — pasted frames from their capture (redacted):

```
SSE: event:token
data: {"request_id":"r-8b3f2a","delta_tokens":18,"text":"Hello, wor"}

SSE: event:token
data: {"request_id":"r-8b3f2a","delta_tokens":9,"text":"ld"}

(connection aborted by client)

new connection: SSE: event:token
data: {"request_id":"r-9c4d5e","delta_tokens":120,"text":"Continued generation (fallback model)"}
```

kevin (Runtime): Note the second connection used r-9c4d5e (new id) but same user/session. Billing will show all emit_token events across both request_ids. Dashboard groups by finalized request id, which for the aborted run never finalized.

julian (Billing): That would produce invoice > dashboard. But customer reported invoice > dashboard by ~800k tokens — sounds consistent if many aborted reconnects. Any chance we double-counted the same tokens due to reconnect replay?

ashok (SRE): I queried: emit_token counts for r-8b3f2a = 27 tokens, r-9c4d5e = 790, total raw events 817. Dashboard shows only finalized records for r-9c4d5e (790) but r-8b3f2a never finalized so it's missing. That explains a 27-token gap, not 800k. So there must be more sessions.

maria (Support): Customer says this pattern happened across ~1.1k user sessions during an outage window on 2026-02-17 03:00-04:15 UTC. Can we aggregate by user API key and time window?

ashok (SRE): Doing that now. Query: "emit_token AND api_key:acct-acmemaps AND ts:[1700...1701]" (internal).

metering-bot: automated-report: raw_token_events=2,934,108; finalized_requests_tokens=2,127,092; missing_unfinalized=807,016

julian (Billing): That matches the invoice delta. Looks like a production path where the runtime emitted tokens before finalizing requests and a subsequent internal routing outage prevented finalization events from reaching the request recorder. Invoices use the raw stream so they show the higher number.

eva (AcmeMaps): Why would finalization fail? We didn't change anything client-side.

kevin (Runtime): Two likely causes: 1) client aborts mid-gen (we still emit tokens), 2) the finalization hook that writes the request to the summary table (and dashboard pipeline) failed to ack because the downstream writer was backpressured/errored during that time. We had a transient routing/queue error in region-us-east-1 at ~03:05 — infra incident INC-6064.

ashok (SRE): Confirmed — the request-aggregator kinesis stream returned 503 for ~9m. Emit_token consumer kept writing metering events to raw stream (used by billing), but aggregator consumer dropped finalization messages. That created the delta in dashboard vs invoice.

julian (Billing): Actionable: we need to (1) backfill finalized request records for that time window from raw token events and (2) adjust dashboard to surface an "unfinalized token" line during outages.

maria (Support): ETA on backfill? Customer wants credit if we can't reconcile quickly.

ashok (SRE): Backfill plan: aggregate raw emit_token events grouped by session/request heuristics (same API key + proxied client IP + proxied session id + time window) and reconstruct a best-effort finalized record. I estimate a backfill job ~2-4 hours to run and verify. Will need billing signoff for any provisional credits.

julian (Billing): I'll prepare a reconciliation spreadsheet and provisional credit calc. If backfill yields >=95% match to raw events we'll apply correction to dashboard and no customer credit needed. If not, we offer pro-rated credit for the discrepancy.

kevin (Runtime): Quick mitigation: change runtime to delay emitting billed token events until a minimal finalization marker is reached OR tag emit_token with a finalization flag so downstream can decide. That is a non-trivial product change and will affect streaming latency and memory. Put a short-term patch: include a "maybe_unfinalized":true flag on emit_token events when the client disconnects before finalization — then billing can choose to withhold charging until confirmed.

maria (Support): Good. For AcmeMaps: giving them a status update + expected backfill ETA (4h) and offer to freeze auto-collect if they want a quicker hold on charges.

eva (AcmeMaps): Please do. They're ok waiting for backfill but want a credit if discrepancy persists.

metering-bot: scheduled-backfill-job queued (job-id: backfill-2124000000).

ashok (SRE): I'll own the backfill run and post results here. tagging billing + runtime.

julian (Billing): I'll draft the customer credit language and send to maria for customer-facing.

kevin (Runtime): Filed runtime follow-up RFC to add emit_token finalization flags and a short-term heuristic to reduce premature raw-event billing: RFC-3711.

maria (Support): Summary for thread reply to customer: we found transient aggregator outage that prevented request finalization; raw token events were still billed (invoice) while dashboard missed unfinalized sessions; running backfill job now (ETA 2-4h); billing will reconcile and propose credit if mismatch >5%.

maria (Support): @eva — I'll post the customer-facing note in 15m with job id and contact.

eva (AcmeMaps): Thanks everyone.

ashok (SRE): backfill job started. will update with final counts.

(metering-bot): backfill-2124000000: started at 2026-02-17T04:10:22Z

kevin (Runtime): Perf note: if we implement the finalization-flag approach, we should also emit lightweight "precommit" markers so billing can reconcile without needing raw text. Saves storage.

ashok (SRE): backfill complete. results: raw_token_events=2,934,108; reconstructed_tokens=2,933,980; reconciliation delta=128 tokens (0.004%). Writing corrected finalized records into dashboard index and notifying billing.

metering-bot: backfill-2124000000: completed at 2026-02-17T06:19:12Z; delta=128 tokens; corrected_dashboard_total=2,934,108

julian (Billing): Since backfill reconciled >99.99%, no credit required. I'll update invoice/notes and close the escalation after customer confirmation.

maria (Support): Customer notified and confirms they accept the reconciliation. Closing once I have their reply.

kevin (Runtime): Follow-ups: RFC-3711 + add alerts for "emit_token != finalized_tokens" spike to catch this earlier.

ashok (SRE): Adding alert.

maria (Support): Thanks team — great catch and quick turnaround. :tada:
